title: RDP brute force
about: Many failed logons from one address, then a successful one.

title: Event log cleared (Event Viewer XML export)
about: The Security and System logs are cleared by an account that has no reason to.

title: Backdoor administrator account
about: A new local account is created, given a password reset and added to Administrators.

title: Persistence
about: A Run key, a service, a startup item and a scheduled task, all created within minutes.

title: Suspicious PowerShell (XML export)
about: Script blocks that download and run code in memory.

title: Command-and-control traffic
about: A process talks to an unusual address and transfers a file out.

title: Several stages in one log
about: Discovery, encoded PowerShell, a file transfer and a log being cleared.

title: Program run from a USB stick
about: One finding, rated below high: the verdict stays 'no high or critical findings'.

title: Normal activity
about: Ordinary logons and processes. Nothing should be found.
